seasons_tilt_intro: Earth's 23.5° tilt changes the angle of sunlight and the length of the day. Choose a month, then compare locations to see how the two hemispheres experience opposite seasons.
seasons_height_help: Angle above the horizon; negative means below.
seasons_solar_clock_help: Local solar time puts the Sun highest at 12:00. These are solar hours, not the times on your clock.
seasons_annual_chart_desc: Each bar shows daylight on the 15th of a month. Gold marks the selected month. Values run from zero to 24 hours.
seasons_year_help: Each bar uses the 15th of a month. Gold marks your selected month. Compare June and December, or move the month slider to follow the whole year.
seasons_model_summary: Geometric daylight and solar noon are calculated for representative dates in local solar time.
